title: Column button
description: Compact 8px-radius buttons: a deep navy filled one with a soft top sheen and a white one on a hairline ring. With an arrow, a stem draws in behind the chevron on hover while the chevron slides a few pixels right; the fill and ring deepen over 0.2s.
notes: the arrow animation is CSS only; it stays still under reduced motion
name: column-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: navy fill · secondary: white on a hairline ring

props.name: icon
props.description: trailing icon: an arrow whose stem draws in on hover, a chevron for menus, or none

props.name: fullOnMobile
props.description: stretch to the container's width on phones (below 1024px)
